flags.why: The negative reading is ordinary use of [an phận](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/an_ph%E1%BA%ADn), not a rare meaning.

Lì xì is now widely used across Vietnam, including in [Northern usage](https://duochoalinh.vn/thong-bao-the-le-chuong-trinh-li-xi-may-man-va-than-tai-go-cua-pham-vi-ap-dung-kenh-tieu-dung-mien-bac/), so these regional tags mislead.
flags.fix: Remove the Central and Southern tags.

flags.why: This use belongs chiefly to formal or technical contexts, rather than ordinary casual conversation.
The noun belongs chiefly to formal or technical contexts and needs a register warning.
The common meaning 'application form; application template', used in everyday [university administration](https://www.oude.edu.vn/student/m%E1%BA%ABu-%C4%91%C6%A1n-22/), is missing.
flags.fix: Add: noun | application form; application template. Example: Bạn điền thông tin vào mẫu đơn này. = Fill in your details on this application form.
